name: Thomson problem: charges on the unit sphere

parameters.potential: sum over unordered pairs 1 / Euclidean distance
parameters.objective_unit: Coulomb energy in unit-charge, unit-radius units

search_metadata.algorithm: fixed-iteration coordinate perturbation with simulated-annealing acceptance and best-witness retention
search_metadata.objective_feedback: floating-point exploratory energy; formal scores are recomputed exactly with conservative bounds

source_review.definition: T021-C01 places 32 distinct points on exact unit S2 and minimizes the sum of reciprocal pair distances. The checker reconstructs rational stereographic points and certifies a conservative energy interval.
source_review.primary_sources: The Cambridge Cluster Database N=32 table row reports 412.2612746 for the Ih structure and links to the archived 32.xyz coordinate file. The table describes a lowest located candidate and does not prove global optimality. The coordinate archive SHA-256 is 967ce3e92de2ab459a28d473cb80a501c6efb2c8dd274a66ab9634e7fd44456c.
source_review.open_status: The checked source supports a feasible N=32 candidate, not a proof of global optimality. No exhaustive claim is made.
source_review.independent_method: The human witness was independently reconstructed from archived decimal coordinates as exact rationals. Its certified interval is [4122612746505293102359058597/10000000000000000000000000, 4122612746505293102359059093/10000000000000000000000000] across 496 pairs. The saved best witness has 496 checked pairs, exact unit-sphere equations, independent interval [2061306373252646550377252279566889977/5000000000000000000000000000000000, 10306531866263232751886261397834450009/25000000000000000000000000000000000], and its claimed score is ignored.
source_review.admission: T021-C01 remains accepted by Sol. Its saved best witness is certified with objective interval [103065318662632327518862607/250000000000000000000000, 515326593313161637594313097/1250000000000000000000000]; 496 pairs were checked. The recorded valid and damaged-witness checks are retained in data/best/result.json and data/best/provenance.json.
